answer.text: Reduces fund cash (deducted from margin account/F&O balance) and represents the initial exposure

explanation.text: The Logic: Per page 279, on entering an options contract the total exposure is computed as the option premium paid. Pages 281-283 show the option premium payable recorded as an expense and deducted from the broker F&O margin account balance. The Trap: Treating the premium as income, as having no NAV impact, or as instantly increasing NAV is inconsistent with the workbook's expense-and-margin-deduction treatment for premium paid. Note: Anchor the answer on the paid-premium exposure rule and the F&O margin-account deduction shown in the workbook example.
